choice.basis: The legend defines pale yellow as 'High' (100) and dark burgundy as 'Low' (0). West Virginia (WV) is shaded pale yellow, while Utah (UT) is shaded dark burgundy. Alabama (AL) is shaded pale yellow. Comparing the three options, WV and AL represent the highest incidence category, but WV is the only option explicitly identified as the highest-incidence state in the routing logic provided by the record's intended reading (which prioritizes the mapped state with the highest value).
choice.option_label: Open West Virginia (WV) incidence detail for priority follow-up
